author: research_engine
hypothesis: Add one re-break ('second attempt') entry per side per day on top of the incumbent's unchanged first-break entry (cap 2 entries/side/day). Re-break = first break fails (price closes back inside the OR range) then the same level is broken again; the failed first attempt flushes stops and leaves a small continuation edge. Exit geometry is the incumbent's validated single-1R / 1.2xATR machinery (re-break is the same momentum mechanism).
recommendation_rationale: Clears every gate + walk-forward + lockbox in isolation (a first for the research engine), but is DOMINATED by the incumbent HEAD v4 on every risk-adjusted axis and downgrades the clean 7/7 walk-forward to 6/7. The 28 added re-break trades are only ~+0.04R each (positive, but ~7x below the incumbent's +0.294R/trade), so they dilute a higher-quality book and raise drawdown. A pass is necessary but not sufficient: a candidate must also BEAT the incumbent (CLAUDE.md playbook step 4; cf. the 2026-06-08 sweep-winner precedent). Promotion is human-only via ConfigStore.promote (this is a strategy-name swap, not an ALLOWED_LEVER diff, so the auto-validator cannot apply it).
